next of kin.d: the person who is (or persons who are) most closely related to a given person

next-to-last.d: used of the third or next to final year in United States high school or college

next door.d: at or in or to the adjacent residence

next friend.d: a person who acts on behalf of an infant or disabled person

next.d: nearest in space or position; immediately adjoining without intervening space

nexus.d: the means of connection between things linked in series
